pl-l3d17c1-d1e117.summary: Asks whether Christ willed or prayed for anything that did not happen.

pl-l3d17c1-d1e120.summary: Notes that this may be thought from his words, 'Father, if possible, let this cup pass from me; yet not what I will but what you will' (Mt 26:39), where he seems to distinguish his own will from the Father's.
claims: Christ seems to distinguish his will from the Father's.

pl-l3d17c1.summary: Asks whether Christ willed or prayed for something that did not happen, as his prayer 'Father, if possible, let this cup pass from me; yet not as I will but as you will' suggests, where he seems to distinguish his will from the Father's.
claims: Christ's prayer in Gethsemane seems to distinguish his will from the Father's.
